name: tags_list
description: List review statuses + custom tags. Pass a project/folder reference from folders_list for one project, OR projectReference=all-assets|uploads|favorites|all-spaces for the cross-project vocabulary (same as GET /projects/tags on those feeds). Do not call statuses "tags".
